items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I hired Earl Bostic myself in the first big band I ever worked with.

ctx.x: That phrase was not current among....
No, I didn't know what that was until -- and how to really form chord changes until I hired Earl Bostic myself in the first big band I ever worked with. I'll tell you about that.

So -- but now Malone had tried to tell me this, this other boy, but I couldn't get with that. I just didn't know -- he told me like C, E, G, C and all that kind of stuff. So he was telling me, says, "Now you got to --" He says, "You're doing it, but you don't know what you're doing with it." He says, "You don't know what key you're in, do you, half the time?" I says, "No, really." So he told me how to -- he says, "Well, whatever your last note ends on, that's just about the key it's on." He says, "Of course,…
